decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Proposed Block Plan and Section - drawing no.4350-03 - dated October 2025</li><li>Proposed Plan and Elevations - drawing no.4350-04 - dated October 2025</li><li>Proposed Elevations - drawing no.4350-05B - dated October 2025</li><li>Site/Block Plans - drawing no.4350-06 - dated October 2025</li><li>Design and Access Statement - dated January 2026</li><li>Covering Letter - Q. Square - dated 9th January 2026</li><li>Daylight &amp; Sunlight Report - CHP Surveyors - dated 7th January 2026</li><li>Transport Statement - dated February 2026</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">Prior to commencement of the development, a&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">Car Parking Management Plan</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">&nbsp;must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council&nbsp;</span>to ensure the parking spaces are routinely
monitored and provided in a sufficient manner.<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;"><br></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Prior to commencement of the development, a CLP Pro Forma must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. The details shall include the numbers, size and routes of construction vehicles, provisions within/around the site to ensure that all vehicles associated with the construction works are properly managed to prevent any unwanted disruption to other highway users, and other matters relating to traffic management to be agreed with the licencing officers of the council. Approved details shall be implemented throughout the project period and any changes to the document must be reported back to the council’s planning and highways department.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">No part of the development shall be occupied or used until&nbsp;</span></span>detailed cycle parking arrangements, demonstrating compliance with
London Plan and LCDS requirements, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The cycle storage arrangements shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the life of the development.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>Before any mechanical services plant 
including heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), to which the application refers, is 
used at the premises, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local 
Planning Authority (LPA) which demonstrates that the following noise design requirements 
can be complied with and shall thereafter be retained as approved.
a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical 
services plant to which the application refers, shall be lower than the existing background 
noise level by 5dB at all times when the plant is in operation. 
 Measurements shall be made at a height of 1.2 – 1.5 metres above the adjacent ground 
level and at least 3.5 metres from any sound reflecting surfaces other than the 
 ground or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive 
premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard BS4142:2014. 
 The measurement value shall be adjusted to remove the additional sound energy 
contribution from reflected surfaces other than from the ground. 
 An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of 
access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed 
 to show how the design criteria is achieved. 
b) At all times the plant shall be isolated to ensure that vibration amplitudes which causes reradiated noise do not exceed the limits detailed in table 4 in section 7.7.2 of BS8233:2014 
“Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings”. Alternatively, the plant 
shall be supported on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to reduce the structural 
transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjoining premises, and these shall 
be so maintained thereafter. 
c) A commissioning acoustic test and report shall be undertaken within 7 Days of 
mechanical services commissioning in order to demonstrate that conditions a) 
 and b) above have been achieved. The results of the test shall be submitted to and 
approved in writing by the LPA.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed development shall achieve security standards (based on Secured by Design principles) to 
the satisfaction of the local authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the 
Local Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved 
development. All security measures applied to the approved development shall be permanently 
retained thereafter.&nbsp;</p>
description: Replacement commercial building for Class E(g), B2 and B8 uses.
